About Us

30+ YEARS OF AUTOMOTIVE EXPERIENCE

Jhansi Automobiles Engineering Works brings 30+ years of experience in automobile service and engineering. Our workshop is focused on professional vehicle maintenance, diagnostics, repairs and engineering solutions.

MORE ABOUT US

Vehicle Expertise

SPECIALISTS IN MITSUBISHI PAJERO, PAJERO SPORT & MODERN VEHICLES

Expert automobile engineering and vehicle servicing for Mitsubishi Pajero, Pajero Sport, and modern-generation vehicles. Our workshop focuses on careful diagnostics, engine and mechanical repairs, maintenance, and reliable service tailored to each vehicle.

  • Mitsubishi Pajero
  • Mitsubishi Pajero Sport
  • Modern-generation SUVs and passenger vehicles

Ask us about other vehicle models to confirm workshop support for your vehicle.
